problem: Saying a multirotor "can carry a heavier payload" implies it out-lifts a fixed-wing. In general a fixed-wing drone carries more payload and flies far longer; the multirotor's real advantages are vertical take-off, hovering and precise slow flight.
fix: It suits 10–50 ha, gives about 20–40 minutes of flight, takes off and lands vertically, and can hover over one spot; a fixed-wing generally carries more payload and flies longer but cannot hover.

problem: The note calls the DEM the "ground surface". In the section text a DEM is any elevation grid, a DSM includes buildings and trees, and only a DTM is bare ground. The note contradicts that.
fix: Change the note to "elevation grid" (or label the node "DSM/DEM") so it matches the definitions in Section 3.

problem: PPK is used without being defined, while RTK is defined earlier.
fix: Write "RTK or PPK (post-processed kinematic, where positions are corrected after the flight)".
